import re

def extract_grid(text, label):
    start=text.index(label)
    tail=text[start:].splitlines()[1:]
    rows=[]
    for line in tail:
        if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9 ]+',line.strip()): break
        vals=[int(x) for x in line.split()]
        if len(vals)==28: rows.append(vals)
        if len(rows)==28: break
    return rows
